themes_detail.label: Public Drinking Surge
themes_detail.summary: Public drinking complaints spiked to 3 reports THIS WEEK compared to a 0.2-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 1,100% increase (z-score: 6.35)—signaling a sudden emergence of open-air consumption or enforcement activity in Bed-Stuy's public spaces.
evidence: 3 drinking complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (8-week average)
No prior Reddit or news coverage of this issue in the district
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD 83rd Precinct about enforcement priorities and whether this reflects a real behavioral change or new enforcement focus
Speak with residents on affected blocks about whether they've observed changes in public consumption or street activity

themes_detail.label: Damaged Street Signs Multiplying
themes_detail.summary: Street sign damage complaints hit 3 reports THIS WEEK, up 380% from a 0.6-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 4.91), alongside a 1,100% spike in missing street signs 2 weeks ago—indicating deteriorating wayfinding infrastructure across the district.
evidence: 3 damaged street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% spike, z-score: 4.91)
3 missing street sign complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.2 weekly average (1,100% spike, z-score: 6.35)
Combined signal shows ongoing street sign infrastructure failure
reporting_angles: Walk key blocks (near recent complaints) to document missing or damaged signs; map pattern with DOT
Contact Department of Transportation about maintenance backlog and whether Bed-Stuy is underfunded relative to other Brooklyn districts

themes_detail.label: Tree Planting Requests Explode
themes_detail.summary: New tree requests surged to 4 complaints LAST WEEK compared to a 0.1-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 3,100% spike (z-score: 11.72, highest severity)—suggesting either sudden resident mobilization for greenery or a latent, long-unmet community need.
evidence: 4 tree requests LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (3,100% spike, z-score: 11.72—highest statistical anomaly in dataset)
Community Board budget data shows 'new or expanded park/amenity' as a repeated annual request, indicating sustained underinvestment
867 DOB permits filed in 90 days show heavy construction activity; residents may be seeking green space as counterbalance
reporting_angles: Interview the 4 residents who filed requests last week about what triggered their action—is this coordinated activism or coincidence?
Report on Parks Department tree-planting pipeline and waitlist; compare Bed-Stuy's per-capita tree coverage to other Brooklyn CDs
Connect to broader environmental justice narrative: Bed-Stuy's tree canopy vs. wealthier neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Food Establishment Health Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints jumped to 8 reports LAST WEEK, up 167% from a 3.0-complaint weekly average (z-score: 5.77)—raising questions about restaurant inspections, violations, or food safety compliance in a district with heavy food service activity.
evidence: 8 food establishment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.0 weekly average (167% spike, z-score: 5.77)
Community Board budget data repeatedly requests 'increase health and safety inspections, e.g. for restaurants,' suggesting longstanding resource gap
No recent news coverage; suggests story has not yet broken
reporting_angles: Obtain DOHMH inspection records for the 8 establishments cited last week; identify common violations (temperature, cleanliness, permits)
Interview DOHMH about inspection frequency in Bed-Stuy vs. citywide average; ask if staffing constraints are contributing
Profile 2-3 restaurants facing complaints; get owner and customer perspectives

themes_detail.label: Sidewalk & Sewer Infrastructure Decay
themes_detail.summary: Root/sewer/sidewalk condition complaints spiked to 4 reports 2 WEEKS AGO, up 357% from a 0.9-complaint weekly baseline (z-score: 9.45)—combined with 867 active DOB permits and sustained budget requests for DEP services, indicating aging underground infrastructure strained by recent development.
evidence: 4 root/sewer/sidewalk complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.9 weekly average (357% spike, z-score: 9.45)
867 DOB permits filed in past 90 days (513 alterations, 160 new buildings) suggest heavy subsurface activity
Community Board budget data includes repeated 'other expense budget request for DEP' and infrastructure maintenance requests
reporting_angles: Obtain DEP maintenance records for Bed-Stuy; map recent complaints against active construction sites to determine causation
Interview DEP about aging water/sewer lines in the district and replacement timelines
Report on sidewalk repair backlog; interview residents with hazardous sidewalk conditions about safety risks
